goal: Implement Slice S7 of docs/specs/tri-host-capability-alignment.spec.md: disable ambient Pi Reviewer extensions, discovered skills and MCP, explicitly load only authority-review, narrow Pi tools, and record the remaining Bash and Antigravity guard-only risks without claiming preventive read-only isolation.

acceptance.assertion: Per D8 of docs/specs/tri-host-capability-alignment.spec.md (source: BR-REQ-4): Pi reviewArguments includes --no-extensions --no-skills --no-mcp, an explicit existing absolute authority-review SKILL.md path and --tools read,grep,find,ls,bash while preserving --print --no-session, model, effort and packet. Positive: BR-SCN-3 exposes that exact argv and the explicit skill remains loadable with discovery disabled. Negative: ambient configuration or an implicit skill lookup is absent. Bound: Claude and Antigravity argv are unchanged and Bash is not described as argument-restricted. Agreed seam: tests/cli-review-dispatch.test.ts.

Per D9 of docs/specs/tri-host-capability-alignment.spec.md (source: BR-REQ-5): Pi and Antigravity P5 remain guard-only, and ADR 0037, the capability table and Antigravity README disclose Pi Bash arguments, AG absence of restriction flags, shell-less native-role immutable-Git limits and untracked-file tree-guard coverage. Positive: a maintainer can read the residual risk. Negative: no text declares either CLI preventively read-only or certifies native AG Review. Bound: review_host: antigravity remains supported. Agreed seams: tests/host-capability-contract.test.ts, tests/antigravity-host-package.test.ts.

Per D8 of docs/specs/tri-host-capability-alignment.spec.md (source: BR-REQ-4): this Spec supersedes review-cli-stage D9 by reference and the amended ADR 0037 decision 4 matches the implemented argv, source and bundled explicit-skill path resolution typechecks, and both packages regenerate. Positive: package checks and typecheck pass. Negative: stale generated cli_review code fails. Bound: no new dependency or lockfile change. Agreed seam: package generation plus TypeScript.
